meta_description: Compare current Adopt Me Task Board objectives, rewards, activity types, and daily or bonus slots across the post-revamp base pool.
intro_md: Task Board Tasks turn normal Adopt Me activities into extra Bucks objectives. The board can ask for pet care, shopping, jobs, progression, home visits, trading activity, or help from a friend, so a quiet day rarely stays unemployed.
description_md:
## Completing Daily Tasks

Daily Tasks cover the widest set of activities and pay 25 Bucks when completed. Some objective families change their target by pet rarity, need type, item, or visit goal, so the full task name matters more than the short family label.

Need tasks work well alongside normal pet aging. Shopping, Pizza Shop, Salon, job, home, and trading objectives need more deliberate routing, and several pet progression tasks expect a particular rarity, Neon status, XP target, or age level.

Tasks can accumulate on the permanent board instead of forcing every objective into one play session. Rerolls provide another route when an objective does not fit the pets, supplies, or activities available to you.

## Completing Bonus Tasks

Bonus Tasks pay 100 Bucks and focus on social play. They can ask you to complete a need on a friend's pet, pet that animal, play with a friend for 10 minutes, visit a friend's home for 60 seconds, or host a party.

These tasks depend on another player or a social action, so they need different preparation from normal pet-care objectives. A backpack full of food is useful, but it remains surprisingly bad at accepting a friend request.

## Planning around task variants

Repeated families are separate objectives when their targets differ. Needy, Needier, The Neediest, Daily Routine, Running Errands, and Shopping Spree each use the exact target in the task name and objective text.

Reward does not measure how expensive or time-consuming the objective will be for your account. A shopping task may require buying a named item, while a needs task can line up with progress you already planned to make.
how_it_works_md: Task family groups related objectives, while Objective gives the exact action and target. Reward shows the Bucks payout, Slot separates Daily from Bonus, and Activity identifies the kind of play needed to complete it.
